ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: GuardAurora measures overall sound level on your device while monitoring is on. Audio is not recognized or sent.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: GuardAurora accesses your location only when you tap the location button or start SOS, to show your coordinates, save them in the on-device log, and optionally open them in maps.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: GuardAurora opens your contacts only when you choose a trusted person. Only that contact's name and number are saved, on your device.
